recentItems.title: Football Freestyle Series | Juanro Aguiló - Redefining Limits
recentItems.description:
In this powerful profile, we dive into the incredible journey of Juanro Aguiló, a freestyle footballer who was born with Phocomelia, a rare congenital condition. But he never let that stop him. This isn’t just a story about football. It’s about resilience, identity, and passion that defies expectation.

🌟 From his early days growing up with a visible difference to becoming a global inspiration on the freestyle football stage, Juanro shares how he turned limitations into strengths, and challenges into opportunities.

👉 Watch now and get inspired.
🔔 Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more human stories behind the sport.

recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Ferrari x Puma | Monza Preview
recentItems.description:
As Scuderia Ferrari gears up for the Italian Grand Prix, Puma and Ferrari celebrate two decades of collaboration in a spectacular way! In this video, we take a closer look at the exclusive Monza Limited Edition collection, a stunning tribute to Ferrari's history, and the unforgettable legacy of Niki Lauda’s first Formula 1 World Championship in 1975.

Join us as the iconic Milanese Tifosi Tram is transformed to showcase Scuderia Ferrari HP memorabilia from the past 20 years, with special nods to Lauda's monumental achievement at Monza.

Don’t miss out on this exclusive behind-the-scenes look as Ferrari continues to make history at the iconic Monza circuit.

recentItems.title: Squash Series | Twice Injured, Never Broken – The Amanda Sobhy Story
recentItems.description:
In this feature, we follow the inspiring journey of Amanda Sobhy — one of the top squash players in the world and a trailblazer for American squash.

From picking up a racket at a young age to battling through not one, but two major injuries, Amanda's story is one of resilience, passion, and unshakable determination. As she climbs her way back into the world’s top 10, Amanda shows us what it truly means to fight for your place — and your purpose — in the sport you love.
